title: Portfolio - LLM Eval Harness API
description: Local LLM eval harness + MULTI-MODEL BENCH: receives an eval run with inline golden cases, runs a GATED subject-under-test, scores each output deterministic-first with the 5-type assertion taxonomy (schema/range/format/absence/masking), then grades residual subjective dimensions (1..5 groundedness/relevance/helpfulness/safety) with a GATED LLM-as-judge. Every scored row carries a modelId (key caseId+modelId); Aggregate GROUPS BY modelId into perModel (total, passRate, perRubricMean, meanLatencyMs, totalTokens, estCostUsd, costBasis) + a ranked bench. SUT routing (two nested IFs -> one fan-in): sutMode:'workflow' grades the LIVE product-feedback sibling (6Gc3wmri0tJre07B) as a black box over its real webhook (extracts response.theme, onError:continueRegularOutput -> sutSource:'error', passed=false); sutMode:'model' fans out cases x sutModels and calls Ollama /api/chat (host.docker.internal:11434, temperature:0) per (case,model), extracting the model text as the actual output + eval_count/prompt_eval_count tokens + total_duration latency (sutModels defaults to ['stub','llama3.2:3b'] -> the deterministic stub lane + the live llama3.2:3b lane; an unreachable model -> sutSource:'error', passed=false); anything else uses the deterministic stub SUT (the default). Honest cost: local Ollama is estCostUsd:0 / costBasis:'local-free'; only KNOWN cloud ids in an explicit priceTable get a $ estimate (none used now) — local cost is never fabricated. Judge gate: judgeSource:'ollama' calls a live local llama3.2:3b (format:json) per row with schema-validation + deterministic fallback (judgeSource:'fallback', passed=false), anything else uses the deterministic stub judge (the default). Computes judge-human agreement over an optional humanLabel calibration slice and sets judgeTrust high (>=0.8) else low. Aggregates pass-rate + per-rubric mean and emits a redacted audit event. Regression-vs-baseline delta is deferred to v0.5.0 (regressionDelta:null).
integrations: Live workflow subject-under-test (sutMode:workflow grades product-feedback 6Gc3wmri0tJre07B as a black box) with graceful non-fatal failure

Live multi-model subject-under-test (sutMode:model fans out cases x sutModels, calls Ollama /api/chat per model: stub lane + llama3.2:3b lane) with token+latency capture and graceful non-fatal failure
Per-model cost-quality-latency bench (aggregate.perModel + ranked bench; honest local-free cost)
Live Ollama LLM-as-judge (llama3.2:3b, judgeSource:ollama) with deterministic fallback
sutMode: stub (default) | workflow (live, grades product-feedback as a black box) | model (live, multi-model bench: stub + llama3.2:3b lanes via Ollama)
buildMechanism: sdk-standalone (@n8n/workflow-sdk) compiled to JSON, deployed via n8n public REST API (no MCP). See docs/adr/0002-deploy-via-rest-api-without-mcp.md.
notes: v0.4.0 (multi-model bench): every scored row now carries a modelId (key caseId+modelId); the deterministic assertions + judge operate per row and Aggregate GROUPS BY modelId into perModel [{modelId,total,passRate,perRubricMean,meanLatencyMs,totalTokens,estCostUsd,costBasis}] + a ranked bench. SUT routing went 3-way via a SECOND nested IF: 'SUT Mode = Workflow?' (v0.3.0) and a new 'SUT Mode = Model?' both fan in to 'Run Deterministic Assertions' (chosen over a Switch to keep every gate a uniform IF). sutMode:'model' adds three nodes — 'Fan Out Model Cases' (cases x sutModels), 'Call Model SUT (Ollama)' (httpRequest POST host.docker.internal:11434/api/chat, temperature:0, onError:continueRegularOutput), 'Parse Model SUT (Ollama)' (extracts message.content as the actual output, tokens=eval_count+prompt_eval_count, latencyMs=total_duration/1e6; an unreachable model -> sutSource:'error', empty output -> passed=false). sutModels defaults to ['stub','llama3.2:3b'] and ALWAYS forces the deterministic stub lane in (the reproducible comparison baseline) alongside the live llama3.2:3b lane; a per-request body.sutModels overrides the live list. Honest cost: local Ollama is estCostUsd:0 / costBasis:'local-free' (tokens+latency are the cost signal); only KNOWN cloud ids in an explicit body.priceTable get a labelled cloud-estimate (none used now) — a local $ figure is never fabricated. The stub SUT + stub judge stay the DEFAULT so verify:live stays offline + reproducible (its assertions were extended for the perModel shape; the degenerate single-'model' stub case keeps aggregate.passRate/perRubricMean/judgeTrust/calibration identical). Node floor rose 26 -> 30. New npm run verify:bench (non-CI, like verify:judge) runs the LIVE sutMode:'model' fan-out (stub + llama3.2:3b lanes) with the STUB judge (fixed judge, varying SUT model, to avoid confounding) and prints the per-model triangle + ranked bench + raw JSON. DEFERRED to v0.5.0: regression-vs-baseline delta (decision 5; regressionDelta stays null). Deployed live (id IhmmthDFMKdDbgvp, 30 nodes, active) and verified 2026-05-30 — see ADR-0004 implementation note + README for the captured gate evidence.
